source_environment: legacy C1 rare-safe-region generator; fixed-approval C2 is a paired environment control, not a duplicate independent state
future_covariates: one conditional forecast batch sampled from visible feature history, shared by planner and actual synthetic environment; arrival forecast error held fixed, no actual future labels in planning
no_release_rule: hold H2 dynamic action and future approval fixed; actually exclude future labels from training, planning horizon stays 2
fixed_matched_rule: same H2 dynamic action; hold actual future approvals at the ordinary-only baseline; isolates feedback channel from replanning
primary_mechanism_learner: regularized logistic regression, matched to planner refits
secondary_transfer_learner: GPU XGBClassifier on exactly the same chosen current action; not used for planner selection
stop_rule: do not expand horizon/worlds/candidate family unless matched-learner oracle H2 beats H1 on independent true-generator verification on mean and at least 2 of 3 seeds; actual single-world outcomes are secondary
rank_audit: all verification worlds and finite-family minima are diagnostics only; never used to revise proposals or reselect actions
